system.name: NAISR
system.one_liner: A 3D neural additive model for interpretable shape representation: a template shape deformed by a sum of covariate-wise displacement fields predicted by separate MLPs.

content.variant_note: a training band with one MLP branch per covariate summed into a displacement for a template network, and a testing band that fans the trained block out into four uses
content.argues: Summing one displacement field per covariate keeps each covariate's effect separable, so the same trained parts support reconstruction, evolution, disentanglement and transfer.
content.subject: Covariate-wise MLPs whose displacement fields are added to deform a template queried as an SDF, then four test-time uses on airway shapes.

elements.name: covariates: c = [c_0, ..., c_n]
elements.role: the covariates attached to each input shape
elements.drawn_as: serif text under a grey airway mesh with a red query point p in R^3

elements.name: c_i, p, z input tiles
elements.role: inputs of one covariate branch: covariate value, point coordinates, latent code
elements.drawn_as: vertical stack of three square tiles (light pink, grey, lilac) with bold symbols, bracketed into the MLP; a bordered box with a letter and a slash stands before z

elements.name: MLP (g_i, g_j)
elements.role: covariate-wise network predicting the displacement g_i(p, c_i, z)
elements.drawn_as: three tall rounded bars with a black strip labelled MLP, magenta for covariate i and blue for covariate j, with an ellipsis for further covariates

elements.name: covariate-wise displacement
elements.role: displacement field d_i in R^3 of one covariate
elements.drawn_as: gradient-filled wobbly blob with mesh lines around a grey cube, pink for i and blue for j

elements.name: Displacement Aggregation
elements.role: adds the covariate-wise displacements into the overall displacement d
elements.drawn_as: pale yellow box next to a plus node where curved lines from the blobs meet

elements.name: overall displacement
elements.role: d = sum of the d_i, defined in the target space
elements.drawn_as: purple blob with a cube and mesh, formula d = Σ d_i beneath

elements.name: p̃ = p + d
elements.role: deformed coordinates at which the template is queried
elements.drawn_as: grey tile p entering a plus node, then a tile p̃ with the formula under it

elements.name: template shape T
elements.role: template network queried at p̃ that outputs a signed distance
elements.drawn_as: purple three-bar MLP with a black strip, caption below

elements.name: SDF: s ∈ R
elements.role: signed distance output with its zero level set as the shape
elements.drawn_as: colour contour image from blue through green to yellow with a pale shape outline

elements.name: Φ
elements.role: the trained model used at test time, shown as a grey trapezoid, Φ_i in pink and Φ_j in blue for one covariate
elements.drawn_as: gradient-filled trapezoid block with input tiles on one side and a shape render on the other

elements.name: Inference and Generation
elements.role: estimate ẑ and ĉ from a given shape; generate shapes from ẑ and ĉ
elements.drawn_as: two rows of tiles, trapezoid Φ and a grey airway render, captions estimate ẑ and ĉ and generate shapes

elements.name: Evolution
elements.role: vary one covariate over time to evolve a shape
elements.drawn_as: chain c_i^1 ... c_i^t ... c_i^T into a pink Φ_i with a dashed ẑ p box, bent arrow to a row of seven shapes along a t axis

elements.name: Disentanglement
elements.role: show the effect of each covariate separately
elements.drawn_as: two rows: p ẑ with c_i into pink Φ_i and a pink-brown shape; p ẑ with c_j into blue Φ_j and a blue shape

elements.name: Transfer
elements.role: estimate ẑ and ĉ, then move a shape to new covariates ĉ_j + Δc_j
elements.drawn_as: upper row estimating ẑ and ĉ; lower row 2 years later? with a blue Φ_j and a blue blob holding the transferred shape

lessons.what_to_learn: Split a figure into training and testing with two filled pill labels, and let one colour per covariate follow its branch from input tile through the network, the displacement picture and the test-time block, so the four test-time uses read as re-use of the same trained parts.
lessons.suits: Models whose training builds additive or modular components that are recombined at test time for several uses such as reconstruction, editing or transfer.

evidence: During training we learn the template T and the multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) {gi} predicting the covariate-wise displacement fields {di}.
At test time we evaluate the trained MLPs for shape reconstruction, evolution, disentanglement, and shape transfer.

summary: NAISR is a 3D neural additive model for interpretable shape representation: a template shape is deformed by the sum of covariate-wise displacement fields, each predicted by its own MLP from the point, the covariate and a shared latent code, and the template is queried at p + d. Figure 1 has two bands under filled pills. Under Training, stacked input tiles (c_i, p, z) feed pink and blue three-bar MLPs whose displacement blobs are summed at a plus node, added to p and passed through a purple template MLP to an SDF image. Under Testing, four framed sections show the trained block Φ for inference and generation, evolution, disentanglement and transfer, each with airway shape renders.
summary_zh: NAISR 用逐协变量的 MLP 预测位移场，求和后形变模板，再查询符号距离函数。图分两带：上方“训练”经粉蓝 MLP、位移求和和模板 MLP 得到 SDF；下方“测试”四个分区展示推断生成、演化、解耦和迁移。
notes: The bordered box with a letter before z (o / z) is explained neither in the caption nor in the cited paragraphs, so it is left uninterpreted. The Testing pill heads the four framed sections and the Training pill heads the top band, giving five panels. The count of airway renders is approximate; the digest lists 82 placed bitmaps, many of them tiny tiles for the input tiles. The Φ trapezoids and MLP bars are both model depictions; model_depiction records the MLP bars.
